CustomObject.label: OI Org Health Finding
CustomObject.description: The unified Org Health finding: one durable, identity-stable row per (Section_Key__c, Rule_Id__c, Component_Key__c) — the fingerprint — surviving from the scan that first detected it through every later re-scan (ADR-0027). Owned exclusively by OI_OrgHealthFindingRepository, which upserts by Fingerprint__c and never overwrites the lifecycle fields (Status__c, OwnerId, Due_Date__c, Notes__c, Compensating_Control__c, Resolution_Evidence__c) on re-detection — only the evidence/severity fields refresh. When a condition a prior scan found is no longer detected, the finding is marked Resolved rather than deleted, preserving history (ProductSpecs.md: "when a finding disappears, mark it resolved rather than deleting its history").
